source.title: Delivered, Not Used: Evaluating Agent Memory at Its Point of Use
source.notes: Paper cohort: Profile means, verdict counts, and pass counts verified against retained run artifacts. Reported pass-rate means, across-run standard deviations, eight-decimal episode costs, and baseline-relative cost changes follow the study author's 2026-11-11 table, except Mem0 (L), corrected on 2026-11-13 from retained call usage, and TencentDB, verified against the credited recorder segments with resume cutoffs applied to exclude overlap. Medium thinking effort follows the paper. Supplementary MemoraX results are from four completed runs under /Volumes/T9/swebench/output, verified read-only on 2026-11-12. Profiles are pooled from injudge.report/v27 with equal span weight; empty deliveries are excluded from verdicts. MemoraX cost excludes unpriced cloud search/write charges.
sections: Task success and mean cost per episode
Evaluation units, span triage, and judge usage

rows.notes: Cost covers the 500 credited tasks per run across 14 recorder segments. Resume cutoffs exclude discarded or replayed work; requests without recorded usage have unknown charges.
